item.text:
### (a) Three posts

1. We believe that if superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, it will make every government more effective. Better tools for understanding problems will mean better tools for solving them.

2. We see superintelligent AI as a turning point for government. If built within the next 20 years, it will make every government more effective—from planning infrastructure to delivering public services.

3. We stand for a future where governments can solve problems beyond their current reach. If superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, it will make every government more effective. We must prepare for that transformation now.

### (b) Newsletter opening

We believe that if superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, it will make every government more effective. We see this as a transformation in what public institutions can accomplish: understanding complex problems, coordinating resources, and turning decisions into results. Every government faces limits on expertise, time, and administrative capacity. Superintelligent AI will expand those limits, giving governments stronger capabilities across the work they already do. We must prepare now for that change, building institutions that can put extraordinary intelligence to practical use. Our position is clear: this technology will strengthen governmental effectiveness everywhere, not just in the wealthiest or most technologically advanced countries.
